clauses.why: JOS 15:17 says only 'took it'; the name Kirjathsepher is in the verse just before, so the citation should take it in.
The verses say he delivered Israel and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim; 'from' goes slightly beyond them.
clauses.english: delivered Israel and prevailed against Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia
clauses.ukr: врятував Ізраїля і подужав Кушан-Ріш'атаїма, царя арамського
clauses.deu: erlöste Israel und überwältigte Kusan-Risathaim, den König von Mesopotamien
clauses.spa: libró a Israel y prevaleció contra Chusan-risathaim, rey de Siria

answer.note: The line leaves out that the Spirit of the LORD came upon him and that he judged Israel (JDG 3:10), and that the land had rest forty years (JDG 3:11).
